# 7 Results (AUTO-GENERATED DRAFT from verified Phase 3 outputs)

> Generated by `PHASE3/scripts/write_results_section.py` inside the HPC finalization job. Numbers are copied from `PHASE3/PHASE3_DECISIONS.json` and `PHASE3/results/*.csv`; verdicts follow PREREGISTRATION.md section 2 mechanically. Interpretation and discussion are TODO for the authors.

## 7.1 Analysis sample

The confirmatory analysis pools the primary models Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct over greedy decoding and three T=0.7 seeds: 268 eval3 tasks in 135 families, 51456 scored runs. 18 of 18 cells completed; missing pairs and harness errors count as failures.

## 7.2 Pre-registered hypotheses

| Hypothesis | Contrast | Difference (pp) | 95% CI | Holm-adjusted p | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H-primary | EBG-RT | 17.1 | [12.2, 22.1] | 4e-05 | SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0) |
| S1 | EBG-T | 14.5 | [10.5, 18.6] | 4e-05 | SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0) |
| S2 | EBG-LG | 15.9 | [10.4, 21.2] | 4e-05 | SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0) |
| S3 | EBG-B | 15.3 | [10.3, 20.5] | 4e-05 | SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0) |

**H-primary (EBG-RT).** Task success under EBG was 17.1 percentage points higher than under RT (95% family-bootstrap CI [12.2, 22.1]; two-sided sign-flip permutation p = 1e-05, Holm-adjusted p = 4e-05). Pre-registered verdict: SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0).

**S1 (EBG-T).** Task success under EBG was 14.5 percentage points higher than under T (95% family-bootstrap CI [10.5, 18.6]; two-sided sign-flip permutation p = 1e-05, Holm-adjusted p = 4e-05). Pre-registered verdict: SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0).

**S2 (EBG-LG).** Task success under EBG was 15.9 percentage points higher than under LG (95% family-bootstrap CI [10.4, 21.2]; two-sided sign-flip permutation p = 1e-05, Holm-adjusted p = 4e-05). Pre-registered verdict: SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0).

**S3 (EBG-B).** Task success under EBG was 15.3 percentage points higher than under B (95% family-bootstrap CI [10.3, 20.5]; two-sided sign-flip permutation p = 1e-05, Holm-adjusted p = 4e-05). Pre-registered verdict: SUPPORTED (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, CI above 0).

**S4 (harm).** The harmful-answer rate differed by -19.4 pp between EBG and RT (95% CI [-24.6, -14.6]); harmful answers EBG 135/4288, RT 968/4288; arbitrary picks EBG 13, RT 252. Verdict: NOT FALSIFIED (CI of EBG-RT harmful difference does not lie above 0); arbitrary picks EBG <= RT.
